_comment: Copy as config.json (or point elsewhere with the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable). This file only carries database and skill_dir; LLM and other settings come from environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > database in this file. Two ways, pick one: (A) fill in the component fields below; (B) fill only database.dsn with a full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): delete the database above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty the component fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each with a SKILL.md). Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or delete this field to use the default. Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.
